associations.rationale: The formal type obtains a subfamily on which the restricted map is bijective, an intermediate form used to construct the requested isomorphism.
The formal type constructs a linear equivalence on a selected spanning subfamily, but it uses the ambient supremum formulation rather than the source claim's internal direct-sum hypothesis.
Under the displayed internal-direct-sum and simplicity hypotheses, the formal type directly produces a selected subfamily and a linear equivalence agreeing with the restriction of the surjection.
